guard: Native environment reservation activates the bootstrap lifecycle, preserves its authority family and never resurrects a staged operation
why: The private JWT broker runs the host-private reservation helper with its scoped writer. No bootstrap signing, complete external admission, terminal retirement or hosted agent execution is claimed.

mutations.name: reservation omits bootstrap lifecycle activation
mutations.find:
await activateLifecycleAtUid(reg, { owner: pin.owner, actor: environmentBootstrapActor(pin.instanceId),
    lifecycleUid: pin.lifecycleUid, managerInstance: pin.instanceId });
mutations.expectRed: native activation creates the reserved bootstrap head and open lifecycle gate
mutations.cell: native activation creates the reserved bootstrap head and open lifecycle gate

mutations.name: reservation omits the endpoint authority family marker
mutations.expectRed: native manager gate is family-marked and frozen under the host registration operation
mutations.cell: native manager gate is family-marked and frozen under the host registration operation

mutations.name: reservation resurrects deleted operation coordinates
mutations.expectRed: a stage deletion marker is corruption, not a reusable operation
mutations.cell: a stage deletion marker is corruption, not a reusable operation
